cabinCategories.description: Carnival Spirit interior cabin — the best value Alaska cabin afloat. All the essentials at the most affordable Alaska cruise price from Seattle.
Ocean view cabin with large window — watch Alaska's stunning coastline from your room without breaking the bank.
Private balcony cabin at an incredible value. Enjoy fresh Alaska air and wildlife sightings from your own outdoor space.
Grand Suite with separate living area, whirlpool tub, priority boarding, and Carnival's most spacious accommodation.

inclusions: All meals in main dining and Lido deck buffet

portsOfCall.description: Embarkation at Pier 91 (Smith Cove Terminal). Carnival Spirit is the best value Alaska cruise departing from Seattle.
portsOfCall.name: Seattle, WA

portsOfCall.description: Full day at sea in the scenic Inside Passage — enjoy all of Carnival Spirit's fun amenities while spectacular wilderness scenery rolls by outside.
portsOfCall.name: At Sea – Inside Passage Scenic

portsOfCall.description: Alaska's dramatic capital. Visit Mendenhall Glacier, go whale watching, or explore the quirky downtown waterfront with its famous Red Dog Saloon.
portsOfCall.name: Juneau, AK

portsOfCall.description: A National Historic Landmark frozen in Gold Rush time. The White Pass & Yukon Route Railway offers one of North America's most scenic train rides.
portsOfCall.name: Skagway, AK

portsOfCall.description: Creek Street's colorful history, world-class totem pole parks, and fresh-caught king crab make Ketchikan a fan favorite.
portsOfCall.name: Ketchikan, AK

portsOfCall.description: An evening arrival in British Columbia's charming garden city — stroll the Inner Harbour or visit Butchart Gardens by night.
portsOfCall.name: Victoria, BC

reviewSnippet: "Carnival Spirit is the best deal in Alaska — period. Three generations of our family went and everyone had an amazing time. The kids loved the waterslides and adults loved the low price. Alaska delivered big." — Verified Guest
